emails.subject: Welcome to Daisy Smart Mail, Shivani!
emails.body:
Hello Shivani,

Welcome to your Daisy Smart Mail workspace. Daisy notifies you in real-time when new emails arrive and reads messages aloud with text-to-speech synthesis.

Try clicking "Listen to Email" to test the voice reader, or use Compose to send an email to yourself or any recipient.

Best regards,
Daisy Assistant

emails.subject: Aqua Glassmorphism & Voice Engine Ready
emails.body:
Hey Shivani!

The new Aqua Frutiger Aero dashboard is now active.

Key features enabled:
- Frosted glass cards with soft elevation
- Voice Assistant reader with sentence chunking & playback controls
- Real-time Socket.IO alerts

Feel free to explore Voice Settings to customize the reading speed and tone!
